name: Crunch Time
summary: A funny coding scene and typing game: a red deadline monster creeps up on a frantic developer
about: A developer types as fast as he can while a jagged red monster holding a DUE TODAY page creeps up behind him, the wall clock spins and the code editor fills line by line. It plays on its own as a looping scene, and when you press Start every key you hit pushes the deadline back until the feature ships with confetti. Good for a developer portfolio, a blog header or a playful 404-style extra.
how: Watch the demo loop, then press Start (or the big Type button).
Every key press, or tap on Type!, writes code, scores points and shoves the monster back; fast typing builds a combo multiplier.
Fill the feature bar to ship it: +250, confetti, a screen shake and a dizzy monster, then the next sprint is faster.
If the monster reaches the developer it is game over; your best score is kept and Restart starts again. Escape pauses.
With reduced motion there is no shaking, hopping or flying confetti; score pops simply fade in place.
